name: popsicle
headline: Boost email engagement with Clickaroos
short_description: Email marketing tool that enables marketing teams to easily A/B test images for campaigns.
author: HumanBeans

sections.overview:
Clickaroos is an email marketing tool designed to help marketing teams optimize their campaigns through A/B testing of images. The platform streamlines the process of testing different image variations to identify which versions drive better engagement and conversion rates. Built with Node/Express, MySQL, and Angular, Clickaroos provides a straightforward interface for comparing email image performance. Marketing teams use it to make data-driven decisions about visual content in their email campaigns, reducing guesswork and improving overall campaign effectiveness.
A/B testing product images in promotional emails
Comparing email banner designs to maximize click-through rates
Testing image layouts and sizes for conversion optimization
Analyzing which product photos drive higher engagement in email campaigns
